cues.en: So it's time to start writing some code.
cues.zh: 現在該開始寫程式碼了。

cues.en: We've talked about a lot of different ways to evaluate recommender systems, so let's start by writing the code to make those metrics reality.
cues.zh: 我們談過許多評估推薦系統的方法，因此先寫程式，讓這些指標實際運作。

cues.en: Think of it as test driven development, we're going to write our tests before we write any actual recommender systems, and that's generally a good idea so that you focus on the results you want to achieve.
cues.zh: 把它想成測試驅動開發，在撰寫任何真正的推薦系統之前，先寫測試。這通常是好主意，能讓你專注於想達成的結果。

cues.en: We're going to use an open source Python library called Surprise to make life easier.
cues.zh: 我們會使用一個叫做 Surprise 的開源 Python 函式庫，讓事情簡單一點。

cues.en: You should have already installed that back in the first lecture.
cues.zh: 你應該已經在第一堂講座安裝過。

cues.en: Let's take a look at how it works.
cues.zh: 來看看它如何運作。

cues.en: Let's start by looking at SurpriseLib's documentation online.
cues.zh: 先在線上查看 SurpriseLib 的文件。

cues.en: Surprise is built around measuring the accuracy of recommender systems, and although I've said repeatedly that this is the wrong thing to focus on, it's really the best we can do without access
cues.zh: Surprise 以衡量推薦系統的準確程度為核心。雖然我一再強調這不是應該專注的目標，但如果沒有自己的

cues.en: to a real, large-scale website of our own.
cues.zh: 真實大型網站可用，這確實是我們能做的最佳方式。

cues.en: And it can give us some information about the properties of the algorithms that we're going to work with.
cues.zh: 而且，它也能提供一些資訊，讓我們了解即將使用的演算法特性。

cues.en: It also saves us a lot of work.
cues.zh: 它還能替我們省下很多工作。

cues.en: For example, it can compute things like MAE and RMSE for us.
cues.zh: 例如，能替我們計算 MAE 與 RMSE。

cues.en: Let's have a look at the documentation on the accuracy metrics that SurpriseLib offers us.
cues.zh: 看看 SurpriseLib 提供的準確程度指標文件。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and start Spyder in our RecSys environment.
cues.zh: 在 RecSys 環境中啟動 Spyder。

cues.en: Now, under the Evaluating folder in your course materials,
cues.zh: 接著，在課程教材的 Evaluating 資料夾中，

cues.en: open up RecommenderMetrics.py and let's see what it does.
cues.zh: 開啟 RecommenderMetrics.py，看看它做什麼。

cues.en: RecommenderMetrics is a Python package that just contains function that we can use in code elsewhere.
cues.zh: RecommenderMetrics 是個 Python 套件，只包含可供其他地方的程式碼使用的函數。

cues.en: So what we're building is a library of useful functions for evaluating recommender systems.
cues.zh: 因此，我們建立的是一個用來評估推薦系統的實用函式庫。

cues.en: From the SurpriseLib web site, we can dig into Github to see their actual implementation of the MAE and RMSE metrics.
cues.zh: 從 SurpriseLib 網站可以深入 GitHub，查看 MAE 與 RMSE 指標的實作。

cues.en: There's no point in coding this ourselves when somebody else has already done it and tested it for us.
cues.zh: 既然已有人完成並測試過，我們就沒必要自己重新寫。

cues.en: Let's go back to our RecommenderMetrics package.
cues.zh: 回到 RecommenderMetrics 套件。

cues.en: First, I want to stress again that this course isn't setting out to teach you how to write code in Python.
cues.zh: 首先，再次強調，這門課的目標不是教你如何用 Python 寫程式。

cues.en: As such, we're not going to step through every line of code and talk about what it does, and I'm not going to make you watch me type out thousands of lines of code and make you follow along.
cues.zh: 因此不會逐行解釋程式碼，也不會要你看我打出數千行程式碼，再跟著輸入。

cues.en: Those are great techniques for learning how to code, but my assumption is that you're already familiar with Python, so we can just focus on the algorithms and architecture instead.
cues.zh: 這些都是學習寫程式的好方法，但我假設你已經熟悉 Python，因此可以專注於演算法與架構。

cues.en: If it makes zero sense to you, you really should go take an introductory Python course first.
cues.zh: 如果你完全看不懂，真的應該先上一門 Python 入門課程。

cues.en: That said, let's dive into what's going on in this package.
cues.zh: 話說回來，深入看看這個套件做了什麼。

cues.en: Since Surprise is concerned mostly about making rating predictions, we have to write some code to get top-N recommendations out of it.
cues.zh: 由於 Surprise 主要著重評分預測，我們必須寫一些程式，從中取得 Top-N 推薦。

cues.en: That's what this GetTopN() function does.
cues.zh: 這就是 GetTopN() 函數的工作。

cues.en: It takes in a complete list of ratings predictions that come back from some recommender, and returns a dictionary that maps user ID's to their top N ratings.
cues.zh: 它接受推薦系統傳回的完整評分預測清單，再傳回一個字典，將使用者 ID 對應到各自最高的 N 筆評分。

cues.en: We can also pass in a minimum rating threshold, to prevent us from recommending items we don't think the user will actually love.
cues.zh: 也可以傳入最低評分門檻，避免推薦我們認為使用者不會真正喜愛的項目。

cues.en: The dictionary we return is actually a default dict object, which is just like a normal Python dictionary but it has a concept of default empty values when you try to access a key
cues.zh: 傳回的字典其實是 defaultdict 物件，類似一般 Python 字典，但當你存取

cues.en: that hasn't been used yet.
cues.zh: 尚未使用過的鍵時，會有預設空值的概念。

cues.en: To compute hit rate, we need to pass in both our dictionary of top-N movies for each user ID, and the set of test movie ratings that were left out of the training data set.
cues.zh: 要計算命中率，必須傳入每個使用者 ID 的 Top-N 電影字典，以及從訓練資料集中留下不用的測試電影評分集合。

cues.en: If you remember, we're using a technique called leave one out cross validation, to hold back one rating per user, and test our ability to recommend that left out movie in our top N lists.
cues.zh: 記得，我們使用留一交叉驗證，每位使用者保留一筆評分，測試能否在 Top-N 清單中推薦出那部被留下的電影。

cues.en: Cumulative hit rate, or CHR, works exactly the same way except we now have a rating cutoff value, so we don't count hits unless they have a predicted rating that's higher than some threshold we choose.
cues.zh: 累積命中率，也就是 CHR，運作方式完全相同，只是多了評分門檻；只有預測評分高於指定門檻，才計算命中。

cues.en: You can see where we test for that cutoff on line 57.
cues.zh: 可以看到第 57 行檢查這個門檻。

cues.en: But otherwise this is the same as the hit rate function.
cues.zh: 除此之外，與命中率函數相同。

cues.en: We'll also implement rating hit rate, or RHR, since we talked about that too.
cues.zh: 也會實作評分命中率，也就是 RHR，因為前面也介紹過。

cues.en: This works just like hit rate, but we keep track of hit rate for each unique rating value.
cues.zh: 它與命中率一樣，但會分別記錄每種不同評分值的命中率。

cues.en: So instead of one variable to keep track of hits and the total number of users, we use another dictionary to keep track of the hits and totals for each rating type.
cues.zh: 因此，不是用單一變數記錄命中次數與使用者總數，而是再用一個字典，記錄每種評分類型的命中數與總數。

cues.en: Then at the end, we print them all out.
cues.zh: 最後全部印出來。

cues.en: The other twist on hit rate is average reciprocal hit rank, which again is similar to hit rate.
cues.zh: 另一種命中率變形，是平均倒數命中排名，同樣與命中率類似。

cues.en: The difference is that we count things up by the reciprocal of the ranks of each hits, in order to give more credit for hits that occur near the top of the top-N lists.
cues.zh: 差別是，按每次命中排名的倒數累加，讓接近 Top-N 清單頂端的命中，得到更多分數。

cues.en: Next we can measure coverage, and here we are defining coverage as the percentage of users that have at least one good recommendation above some threshold.
cues.zh: 接著可以衡量覆蓋率，這裡定義為：至少有一個超過指定門檻的好推薦的使用者，占全部使用者的百分比。

cues.en: In the real world, you would probably have a catalog of items that is larger than the set of items you have recommendations data for, and would compute coverage based on that larger set instead.
cues.zh: 真實世界中，項目目錄通常比有推薦資料的項目集合更大，會改以那個更大的集合計算覆蓋率。

cues.en: But for the data we have to work with in MovieLens, this is the most interesting measure of coverage I can come up with.
cues.zh: 但就目前能使用的 MovieLens 資料來說，這是我能想到最有意思的覆蓋率定義。

cues.en: The code itself is straight-forward.
cues.zh: 程式碼本身很直接。

cues.en: Next we'll tackle diversity.
cues.zh: 接著處理多樣性。

cues.en: To measure diversity, we not only need all of the top-N recommendations from our system, we need a matrix of similarity scores between every pair of items in our data set.
cues.zh: 衡量多樣性，不只需要系統所有的 Top-N 推薦，還需要資料集中每一對項目之間的相似度分數矩陣。

cues.en: Although diversity is easy to explain, coding it is a little tricky.
cues.zh: 雖然多樣性容易解釋，寫成程式卻有點棘手。

cues.en: We start by retrieving the similarity matrix, this is basically a 2 by 2 array that contains similarity scores for every possible combination of items that we can quickly look up.
cues.zh: 首先取得相似度矩陣，這基本上是一個 2×2 陣列，包含所有可能項目組合的相似度分數，方便快速查詢。

cues.en: Then, we go through the top-N recommendations for each user, one user at a time.
cues.zh: 接著，逐一處理每位使用者的 Top-N 推薦。

cues.en: This itertools.combinations call gives us back every combination of item pairs within the top-N list.
cues.zh: 這個 itertools.combinations 呼叫，會傳回 Top-N 清單中所有項目配對組合。

cues.en: We can then iterate through each pair, and look up the similarity between each pair of items.
cues.zh: 然後就能走訪每一對，查詢它們的相似度。

cues.en: This is as good a time as any to mention that Surprise maintains internal ID's for both users and items that are sequential, and these are different from the raw user ID's
cues.zh: 這裡也順便提一下，Surprise 會替使用者與項目維護連續的內部 ID，它們與實際評分資料中的原始使用者 ID

cues.en: and movie ID's that are in our actual ratings data.
cues.zh: 及電影 ID 不同。

cues.en: The similarity matrix uses those inner ID's, so we need to convert our raw ID's to inner ID's before looking up those similarity scores here.
cues.zh: 相似度矩陣使用內部 ID，因此在這裡查詢相似度之前，必須把原始 ID 轉成內部 ID。

cues.en: We add up all those similarity scores, take the average, and then subtract it from one to get out diversity metric.
cues.zh: 將所有相似度分數加總、取平均，再用一減去它，就得到多樣性指標。

cues.en: As you can imagine, running this code across every possible combination of recommended items for every user in our data set is pretty intensive computationally.
cues.zh: 可以想像，對資料集中每位使用者、每種可能的推薦項目組合，執行這段程式，運算負擔相當重。

cues.en: In the real world on larger data sets, it might make sense to sample your data when computing this.
cues.zh: 真實世界的大型資料集，計算這項指標時，也許應該對資料取樣。

cues.en: Finally we'll tackle Novelty, which is a lot easier.
cues.zh: 最後處理新穎性，這簡單得多。

cues.en: We'll take in a handy dictionary of popularity rankings of every item as a parameter, and then it's just a matter of going through every user's top-N recommendations
cues.zh: 我們會傳入一個方便的字典，記錄每個項目的熱門排名，接著只要走訪每位使用者的 Top-N 推薦，

cues.en: and computing the average of all the popularity rankings of every item that was recommended.
cues.zh: 計算所有被推薦項目的熱門排名平均值。

cues.en: All right, so now we have the tools we need to evaluate recommender systems.
cues.zh: 好，現在已經有評估推薦系統所需的工具。

cues.en: Next, let's try them out on a real recommender.
cues.zh: 接著，拿真正的推薦系統試試看。
